description: Hemmed-wall tray flat-pattern golden — the TB-1 founder-dogfooding part (BACKLOG 2026-07-20): base flange 300 x 180, t = 1.5 mm, wall bend radius 2 mm, K = 0.44; FOUR 90-deg edge flanges (walls) leg 80 off the top-face edges; an OPEN HEM (return 8 mm, inner radius 1 mm -> a 2 mm air gap, i.e. inside diameter 2 mm on 1.5 mm gauge, at/above the 1-gauge minimum an open hem is defined by) on BOTH long walls' top inner rims. NB HEM-1 (2026-08-28) retyped these two hems from 'closed' to 'open': their geometry and this golden's every expectation, content_hash included, are BYTE-IDENTICAL across that change, which is the proof they were open hems all along under the wrong label; FOUR rectangular corner reliefs (ratio 1.5 -> size 2.25). Guards the two fixes that make a hem on a FLANGE top edge flat-pattern: (1) bend flank resolution is TOPOLOGICAL (a flange must share an edge with the bend cylinder, resolve._shares_edge_with) so the perpendicular walls' end faces — exactly coplanar with the hem return's tangent plane — no longer inflate the flank count to 4 (the filed BendFlankingFacesError); (2) the relieved unfold accepts axis-parallel returns off depth-1 arms by FOLD PROVENANCE (unfold._partition_arm_returns) and develops each hem as a pure arm extension [BA strip][return leg] beyond the wall rim. A hem is a 180-deg fold: BA = pi * (r + K*t), the same closed form the closed-hem-plate golden proves on a base-plate edge (sheet-metal.md SS1/SS4.3/SS4.4/SS9; parity SS2).
derivation: Expectations are HAND-DERIVED analytic values, not recorded harness output (geometry-gates skill). Wall bend allowance (SS1): BA_wall = (pi/2) * (2 + 0.44*1.5) = (pi/2) * 2.66 = 4.178318229274425 mm. Hem allowance: BA_hem = pi * (1 + 0.44*1.5) = pi * 1.66 = 5.215043804959057 mm. Relief size = relief_ratio * t = 1.5 * 1.5 = 2.25 mm (SS4.4.3).

Blank extents (SS9 #1, tangent-line convention): across the hemmed axis = 8 + BA_hem + 80 + BA_wall + 180 + BA_wall + 80 + BA_hem + 8 = 356 + 2*BA_wall + 2*BA_hem = 374.78672406846696 mm; across the short-wall axis = 80 + BA_wall + 300 + BA_wall + 80 = 460 + 2*BA_wall = 468.35663645854885 mm. The relieved path's frame reports these as flat_length / bend_width respectively; the unrelieved TREE path (reliefs dropped) reports the same two numbers with the axes swapped.

Unrelieved developed area (SS9 #2): flats 135600 (base 54000 + walls 2*24000 + 2*14400 + hem returns 2*2400) + wall BA strips 960*BA_wall + hem BA strips 600*BA_hem = 142740.21178307888 mm^2. Relief removal (SS4.4.4, local corner notches): 4 corner squares (s^2) + 8 flange notches (s * (BA_wall + s)) = 20.25 + 115.70972812693965 = 135.95972812693966 mm^2. flat_area = 142604.25205495194 mm^2.

Fold lines: the four wall folds are shortened by s at each notched end (300 -> 295.5, 180 -> 175.5); the two hem folds stay FULL width 300 (the relief notch is at the wall ROOT, the hem is at the RIM). Each hem fold centerline sits 8 + BA_hem/2 = 10.607521902479529 mm in from its blank edge. All folds are 'up' (walls fold to +Z; each hem return folds onto the +normal side of its wall's inner face).

Removed 3D volume (fold-back, SS4.4.4): removed_flat_area * t + the neutral-vs-mean-radius bend term over all 8 flange notches, 8 * s * (pi/2) * t^2 * (0.5 - K) = 3.817035074111599 -> 207.75662726452106 mm^3; equivalently, per notch, s * (bend cross-section 8.25*pi/4 + s*t) plus 4 base corner squares s^2*t — the two derivations agree to the last ulp. relieved_volume = 214360.60525624720 mm^3 (measured residual 1.4e-10).

Fold-back invariant witnesses (measured on the REAL evaluated bodies): the LIVE relieved body's inner bend cylindrical-face widths at r=2 equal the flat wall fold widths [175.5, 175.5, 295.5, 295.5] and at r=1 equal the hem fold widths [300, 300]; the CLEAN reference body's r=2 widths are the unrelieved [180, 180, 300, 300].

content_hash is the sha256 of the pipeline FlatPattern.to_json_bytes() — a DETERMINISM PIN (byte-identity), not analytic; reproducible in-process and across a fresh interpreter restart (SS9 #4). A change WITHOUT a kernel-version bump is a determinism regression (P0), never a retry.
tolerance_rationale: Measured first, then set (geometry-gates skill; build123d 0.11.1 / OCCT 7.9, 2026-07-22): flat_length residual 6e-14, flat_area residual 4e-11, bend-width residuals 3e-14, BA residuals <= 4e-14 (the wall bends' resolved radii carry ~2.5e-14 arc-fit jitter; the hem's r=1 resolves exactly). Documented ceiling 1e-9 gives ample platform-FP headroom while staying tighter than the standing kernel linear tolerance (1e-7 m). The volume tolerance (1e-6) absorbs arc-fit noise scaled by the 300 mm bend widths (measured residuals <= 5.3e-10).
